u0: This is the neutral starting stage, with no required reaction currently outstanding. The agent can wait or move about until the siren starts, a client arrives, the pot boils over, or food slips; those events create the duties it must handle. There is no terminal success point, so the shop continues reactively from one event to the next.
u1: The stove has been turned down after a boil, so that boil is no longer active. Because the stove is handled with empty hands, the agent still owes a food pickup and should retrieve the portion it set down, or otherwise take food again. Later sirens, clients, and boils can add new duties, but this post-shutdown pickup must not be forgotten.
